name: Foundation Layouts
description: Provides ZURB Foundation grid system layouts.
project_description:
This module integrates ZURB Foundation layout system with Drupal 8 Layout plugin in order to provide a responsive and easy to manage way for site builders to display content and page elements.

 For a more efficient workflow we recommend using this module with modules that utilize the Layout plugin module such as Display Suite and Panels 

 This module was based on the Bootstrap Layouts module for Drupal 8

 Requirements 

 
 ZURB Foundation or any theme that use the Foundation grid system. 
 Layout Plugin Display Suite, Panels or any project that uses Layout Plugin 
 
 Currently supported versions 

 
 8.x-5.x: (Drupal core < 8.3.0) This branch requires the contrib module Layout Plugin 
 8.x-6.x: (Drupal core >= 8.3.0) This branch requires the bundled core layout_discovery module
